title: Global Sets | Deleting an unused value, or opening "Where is this value used" on it, crashes the Settings page
env: NDC-Staging · staging-crm · ndc-staging-owner · Setup › Modules and Fields › Global Sets › "QA RT19 GS Tier" › Unused value "Copper" · 16 Nov 2026

panels.caption: Edit Global Set: Unused Values (1) "Copper" with "Where is this value used" and Delete icons
After clicking either icon: "Something went wrong" (the whole Settings page is replaced; unsaved edits are lost)
The API behind it works: used value 422, unused value 200 (deleted), unused value still on a record 409, two at once 422

rows: Unused value shown in the editor
Click "Where is this value used" on Copper
Panel listing where the value is used (or that it is not used)
Page crashes: "Something went wrong · An unexpected error occurred" (console: TypeError reading 'length')
Confirm, then the value is deleted for good
Same crash; the value cannot be deleted from the screen
Works: unused 200, used 422 NOT_UNUSED, on a record 409 IN_USE, two at once 422
